summary: Cleanup invokes the stored callback with undefined this and one heldValue argument.

tests.name: held value callback contract
tests.input: const f=new FinalizationRegistry(function(v){ 'use strict'; console.log(this===undefined,v); }); const x={}; f.register(x,7); console.log('registered')
tests.expected_behavior: registration succeeds; if cleanup later occurs callback receives undefined this and 7

tests.name: held object identity contract
tests.input: const h={}; const f=new FinalizationRegistry(v=>console.log(v===h)); const x={}; f.register(x,h); console.log('registered')
tests.expected_behavior: if cleanup occurs it receives the exact held object
